critical_code_review_comments: APIVersionRewriteMiddleware correctly runs at the outermost layer (added via add_middleware AFTER register_middleware in server.py), so downstream auth/CSRF/rate-limit see canonical /api/* — matches problem statement design.
raw_path is updated in the ASGI scope, but scope.get('route_root_path') / scope.get('root_path') are untouched (they were empty, which is fine). Good.
WebSocket branch short-circuits before wrapping send() — correctly avoids header injection on ws frames.
X-API-Version header appended as bytes tuple to response headers — Starlette/FastAPI accepts this; verified via TestClient AND public ingress.
routes/api_docs.py imports require_admin from .db — depends on Depends(require_admin) which raised 401/403 correctly for unauthenticated and 200 for admin bearer. No leak of schema.
client_bootstrap.py: base_paths.versioned=/api/v1, base_paths.legacy=/api — matches the pytest contract; theming block returns v2-light-dark app + v7-light-dark email as required.
utils/public_api_contract.py must list /api/client/bootstrap in PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES for the deny-by-default auth gate to allow the unauthenticated call — verified 200 without auth on ingress path.
OpenAPI schema returned by /api/v1/openapi.json is FastAPI's app.openapi() with info.version overridden to 1.0.0 — safe (no route filtering; docs remain admin-gated so no info-disclosure concern).
Zero-regression: 25/25 pytest + 15/15 external ingress + full frontend flow — nothing else was touched.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web-First Multi-Platform API v1 shim is fully validated. The new test file /app/backend/tests/test_api_v1_curl_public_verification.py exercises the ingress URL and is safe for regression re-runs. The v1 alias only rewrites /api/v1/* → /api/* and stamps X-API-Version:1 on the response; legacy /api/* is byte-for-byte unchanged (confirmed by presence/absence of the header). Native auth is signaled via header X-Client-Platform (values: mobile/native/android/ios/expo) — this MUST be paired with X-Requested-With:XMLHttpRequest for CSRF. Admin session_token from native login unlocks /api/v1/openapi.json.
